## How to Use

- Each slide contains one tidyverse practice question.
- Fill in the blanks marked as `_____`.
- These tasks cover core verbs, recoding, reshaping, joins, and cleaning.

## Setup Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)

clinic_wide <- tibble(
  id = 1:6,
  sex = c("Female", "Male", "Female", "Male", "Female", "Male"),
  age = c(22, 34, 29, 41, 37, 26),
  bmi = c(19.8, 27.2, 31.1, 24.3, 29.4, 22.6),
  fbs_0 = c(88, 110, 132, 96, 124, 91),
  fbs_3 = c(86, 104, 120, 94, 118, 89),
  ppbs_0 = c(126, 168, 214, 142, 176, 130),
  smoker = c("No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "No")
)

clinic_long <- tibble(
  id = c(1,1,2,2,3,3,4,4),
  visit = c("baseline", "3m", "baseline", "3m", "baseline", "3m", "baseline", "3m"),
  fbs = c(88, 86, 110, 104, 132, 120, 96, 94)
)

treatment_map <- tibble(
  id = 1:6,
  treatment = c("Diet", "Metformin", "Insulin", "Diet", "Metformin", "Diet")
)
```
:::


## Exercise 1

Select only `id`, `age`, and `bmi`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(id, age, bmi)
```
:::


## Exercise 2

Filter participants with BMI 25 or more.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(bmi >= 25)
```
:::


## Exercise 3

Create a new column `bmi_group` where BMI is classified as:

- `<25` = `"Normal"`
- `25 to <30` = `"Overweight"`
- `>=30` = `"Obese"`


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  mutate(
    bmi_group = case_when(
      bmi < 25 ~ "Normal",
      bmi >= 25 & bmi < 30 ~ "Overweight",
      bmi >= 30 ~ "Obese"
    )
  )
```
:::


## Exercise 4

Create `age_group` as `"Under30"` or `"30plus"` using `mutate()`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(age_group = if_else(age < 30, "Under30", "30plus"))
```
:::


## Exercise 5

Arrange rows from highest to lowest baseline FBS.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(desc(fbs_0))
```
:::


## Exercise 6

Find mean BMI by sex.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(sex) %>%
  summarise(mean_bmi = mean(bmi))
```
:::


## Exercise 7

Count participants by smoking status.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(smoker)
```
:::


## Exercise 8

Convert `clinic_wide` from wide to long for the two FBS columns.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = _____,
    names_to = "visit",
    values_to = "fbs"
  )
```
:::


## Exercise 9

Convert `clinic_long` from long to wide so each visit becomes a separate column.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = _____,
    values_from = fbs
  )
```
:::


## Exercise 10

Join treatment information into `clinic_wide` using `id`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(treatment_map, by = "id")
```
:::


## Exercise 11

Rename `fbs_0` to `fbs_baseline`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(fbs_baseline = fbs_0)
```
:::


## Exercise 12

Move `smoker` to appear right after `sex`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

  _____(smoker, .after = sex)
```
:::


## Exercise 13

Keep only distinct combinations of `sex` and `smoker`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  _____(sex, smoker)
```
:::


## Exercise 14

Create a flag `high_fbs` that is `TRUE` when baseline FBS is 126 or more.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  mutate(high_fbs = _____ >= 126)
```
:::


## Exercise 15

Create a variable `fbs_change` equal to 3-month FBS minus baseline FBS.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  mutate(fbs_change = _____ - fbs_0)
```
:::


## Exercise 16

Use `select()` to keep all columns except `ppbs_0`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  select(-_____)
```
:::


## Exercise 17

Filter female participants younger than 30 years.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  filter(sex == "Female", _____ < 30)
```
:::


## Exercise 18

Summarise the maximum baseline PPBS.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  summarise(max_ppbs = _____(ppbs_0))
```
:::


## Exercise 19

Create a categorical FBS variable from baseline values:

- `<100` = `"Normal"`
- `100 to 125` = `"Prediabetes"`
- `>=126` = `"Diabetes"`


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  mutate(
    fbs_status = case_when(
      fbs_0 < 100 ~ "Normal",
      fbs_0 >= 100 & fbs_0 < 126 ~ "Prediabetes",
      fbs_0 >= 126 ~ "Diabetes"
    )
  )
```
:::


## Exercise 20

Group by sex and summarise mean baseline FBS and mean baseline PPBS.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
clinic_wide %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fbs = mean(_____),
    mean_ppbs = mean(ppbs_0)
  )
```
:::

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
